faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from Starlite Marbella?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is roughly 15 minutes by car from the Starlite venue at Cantera de Nagüeles. A taxi costs around €20–€30 each way. If you charter a boat, we recommend docking at Puerto Banús by 21:00 to allow time for the short drive.

faq.q: Can I combine a yacht charter with a Starlite concert on the same evening?
faq.a: Absolutely. A popular plan is a 2-hour sunset charter (18:00–20:00) on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, then head to Starlite for the 22:00 concert. For a longer evening, book an 8-hour charter (€2,299) and enjoy both the boat and the concert.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

faq.q: Which yacht is best for a pre-concert group outing?
faq.a: For groups up to 9, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) is ideal. For up to 11, choose the Azimut 39 (same price). Larger groups of 12 can book the Mangusta 80 (from €4,719/4h) or the Azimut 58 Flybridge.

faq.q: How do I book a yacht for Starlite 2030?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and pricing. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly at the rates shown. For larger yachts, we’ll provide a custom quote within hours.

faq.q: What time should I arrive at Puerto Banús for a pre-concert charter?
faq.a: Arrive at least 15 minutes before your charter start time. We recommend a 18:00 departure for a 2-hour trip, giving you a relaxed sunset cruise followed by dinner on the Golden Mile before the concert.

faq.q: Is there parking near Puerto Banús for Starlite concert-goers?
faq.a: Puerto Banús has several paid parking garages (approx. €3/hour). For convenience, many guests take a taxi from their hotel or the port directly to Starlite. We can arrange a private transfer upon request.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks on the charter?
faq.a: Our charters already include a selection of drinks and snacks. If you have specific dietary requirements or want to bring a special bottle, please let us know in advance. We can accommodate most requests.

data.body_html:
Starlite 2030 Marbella is set to be the Costa del Sol’s most glamorous summer festival, drawing international headliners to the stunning Cantera de Nagüeles quarry. But why limit your evening to just a concert? Combine your night with a luxury yacht charter from Puerto Banús for an unforgettable sunset cruise before the show. With our fleet of premium motor yachts, you can sip cava as the sun dips behind La Concha, then step ashore for world-class music. This guide covers everything you need to plan the perfect Starlite 2030 yacht charter experience.

Why Combine a Yacht Charter with Starlite 2030?

Starlite concerts typically start at 22:00, leaving your evening wide open. A pre-concert yacht charter lets you make the most of Marbella’s golden hour on the Mediterranean. You’ll cruise past the mansions of the Golden Mile, anchor off Cala del Faro for a swim, and enjoy complimentary drinks and snacks—all before the main event. It’s a seamless way to elevate your night from great to legendary.

Our Fleet for Starlite 2030 Evenings

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, just a 15-minute taxi ride from Starlite. Here are the top choices for concert-goers:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Ideal for intimate groups.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing as Astondoa 40. Slightly more space.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719/4h, includes a free jet ski. Perfect for a VIP crowd.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – the ultimate luxury statement. Contact us for a quote.

For smaller groups, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) offer a sportier, more affordable option—pricing on request.

Sample Starlite 2030 Itinerary

Here’s a typical evening plan using a Tier A boat:

  • 18:00 – Board your Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at Puerto Banús.
  • 18:15 – Depart towards Cabopino or Cala Cortés for a sunset swim stop.
  • 19:30 – Return towards Puerto Banús, enjoying drinks and snacks.
  • 20:00 – Dock and freshen up. Grab a quick bite at a port-side restaurant.
  • 21:30 – Taxi to Starlite (€20–€30).
  • 22:00 – Concert begins.

If you book an 8-hour charter (€2,299), you can extend the cruise post-concert or include a late dinner on board.

Pricing & Inclusions

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. No hidden fees. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for 4 hours (jet ski included). For all other boats, simply contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

Getting from Puerto Banús to Starlite

Puerto Banús is approximately 8 km from the Starlite venue at Cantera de Nagüeles. A taxi takes 10–15 minutes and costs around €20–€30. Alternatively, you can arrange a private driver through us for a fixed fee. If you’re staying on the Golden Mile, many hotels offer shuttle services to Starlite.

What to Wear & Bring

Marbella evenings in July–August average 24–28°C. For the yacht, bring swimwear, a light cover-up, sunglasses, and sunscreen. For Starlite, dress code is smart-casual to glamorous—think linen shirts, dresses, and comfortable shoes (the quarry floor is uneven). Don’t forget your concert ticket and ID.

Booking Your Starlite 2030 Yacht Charter

Reserve early—Starlite 2030 is expected to sell out, and our fleet books up quickly. For Tier A boats, you can confirm instantly at the published rates. For larger yachts, we’ll respond within 2 hours with availability and pricing. All bookings are handled via WhatsApp for speed and flexibility.
